command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode` can corroborate BIOS version and release date, but BMC FRU board info is not the BIOS Main-page field and neither command observes Compliancy or Core Version. Insecure sshpass/host-key bypass is unacceptable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After the field decision, capture the exact BIOS Main-page label/value through validated console access, compare it with the approved build manifest and SMBIOS/vendor readback, then exit setup without saving.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS setup Main page, source field labels, correctness criterion and 5/5-minute timing are preserved; no label equivalence or expected value is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a UI-to-build evidence tuple containing platform ID, BIOS image/build ID, exact screen label/value, SMBIOS Type 0 value and approved mapping version.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative semantics and UI evidence instead of substituting OS/FRU strings.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Would distinguish a correct BIOS image from a correct-but-different compliancy/core package identifier.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendors may expose Core Version, compliancy level and release version as distinct fields; string similarity is not proof of equivalence.

project_override_considerations: Master remains unchanged. The review layer must not silently rename `Compliancy` to `Core Version` or treat generic FW Version as both until engineering approves the mapping.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items names a firmware-version check, Procedure requests `Compliancy`, and Criteria requires `Core Version`. These may be distinct vendor fields and the source does not define their relationship.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only UI purpose is recoverable and a precise engineering decision can identify the field and oracle. This is REQUIRES pending that decision, not irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Prevents OS SMBIOS or BMC FRU evidence from falsely satisfying an unresolved BIOS Main-page field and preserves all conflicting Master wording for decision.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware release, core codebase version and compliance level can advance independently. Because the source uses all three concepts without mapping them, selecting one string would be a semantic guess. A read-only console check is technically straightforward once the authoritative field and build oracle are approved, so the case remains REQUIRES with a tracked conflict.
